GTI_TEAM_SETTINGS.TITLE: Queue greeting
GTI_TEAM_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Sent to the customer on WhatsApp when the conversation enters this queue.
GTI_TEAM_SETTINGS.GREETING_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Hi {{firstname}}, you are in {{queue}}. An agent will reply shortly.

MEDIA.LABEL: Image or audio
MEDIA.HELP: Optional. An image goes with the message; an audio is sent right after it (recorded audio arrives as a voice note).
MEDIA.INVALID: Choose an image or an audio file.
MEDIA.RECORD_ERROR: Could not record the audio. Check the microphone permission.

GTI_TEAM_SETTINGS.OUT_OF_HOURS_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: We are closed now, {{firstname}}. We will reply when we open.
GTI_TEAM_SETTINGS.OUT_OF_HOURS_HELP: Sent instead of the greeting while the connection is outside its working hours.
